page.overview:
Who is Hyōi Yorishiro?

As a longstanding thief, Hyōi is immoral by nature. He cares not how his actions can affect others, only on the prize and how he will prosper from it. He is also very arrogant, constantly assuming that he will not be caught and as such gets careless.

Hyōi is a man of below-average height with fair skin and a skinny build. He has brown eyes, no eyebrows, and brown hair styled as a high pompadour with a streak of red going down the centre. He wears a simple grey vest and pants with white straps around his midsection.

Hyōi excels in infiltration, enough to earn a spot in the Bingo Books. His signature skill is to disguise his chakra to perfectly imitate another person. It is effective enough to fool an advanced Sensing Barrier. Combining it with the Transformation Technique, he can effectively move about places unnoticed.

Hyōi's string of thefts eventually brought him to Konohagakure, where he impersonated a local worker. As he casually began collecting goods, he was found out by Inojin Yamanaka, who detected a small fluctuation in Hyōi's disguised chakra. Hyōi was swiftly subdued by Inojin and his friends, prompting the Konoha Barrier Team to begin researching and developing in filters for their security system to detect such disguises.
